verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships a built-in LLM chat window that can link to sessions for context-aware help, run commands on the user's behalf, and annotate output. It is enabled through a first-party optional AI plugin. A community hands-on report confirms using it to generate an awk command quickly. It requires installing the separate plugin and supplying your own API key, and the depth of agentic delegation is only briefly described. missing for 10: in-depth docs on multi-step task delegation and approval controls, independent corroboration of the run-commands-on-your-behalf capability, a built-in model without bring-your-own key.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Built-in LLM chat window that can optionally interact with terminal contents. Link sessions to get context-aware help, run commands on your behalf, or explain output with annotations.
This is an optional component you can install to enable generative AI features in iTerm2.
One user prompted the iTerm2 AI feature to use awk to filter the 2nd and 5th columns of piped input and truncate the 5th to 25 chars.
